result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

In `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` added to its count subquery. The other per-rep queries filter the same way. Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the sort order is unchanged. I also added "cancelled ones are left out" to that method's Javadoc.

I ran the tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*` and they passed. I didn't add a new test or run your Anna/Bob example.
